name: Yang Complex of a Marked Section
statement: For a class $M$ on visible and auxiliary coordinates and a realized auxiliary mark $\tau$, the Yang complex of the section is the link $\Delta_{M[\tau]}=\operatorname{lk}_{\Delta_M}(\sigma_\tau)$ on the remaining literal pairs, after discarding opposite auxiliary ghost vertices.
proof: A visible literal face lies in the link exactly when adjoining all marked auxiliary literals yields a face of $\Delta_M$. This is equivalent to extension by a word of $M$ with auxiliary restriction $\tau$, hence to membership in the Yang complex of the marked section.
